description: Review of every original in assets/images. Originals are never edited, renamed, moved or deleted, and are git-ignored. 'shows' is from visual review, not the filename. status: cleared (source and license confirmed), unverified (not yet confirmed; do not publish), excluded (never used). use: recipe:<id> (shows that dish), brand:<screen> or header:<screen> (one supporting image), held (kept for a future matching recipe), near-duplicate (the other file of the pair is kept), excluded. Variants are built by tools/images for every entry that is not excluded and not a nearDuplicateOf another kept file.
